note.ja: 自己触媒反応の空間拡張。反応平衡と分散関係から模様の発生を検証するための数理モデルです。 限定した実行例：a=0.1,b=0.9、拡散係数0.01/1、長さ2πの1次元周期Schnakenberg系。旧線形発現例を保持し、固定した反射対称の有限振幅初期値の非線形発展と成長後パターンを独立Fourier–Galerkin/Radau参照および空間・時間細分化で比較します。一般の模様選択、2次元、生物実験への較正、流体連成には広げません。
note.en: A simple autocatalytic kinetic law extended in space, useful for reproducible Turing-onset tests. A mathematical chemical pattern model; matching a visual biological pattern does not calibrate it to a tissue. Scoped executed example: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. No general pattern selection, 2D, biological calibration or fluid-coupling claim.

note.ja: 2成分反応拡散の枠組み。f・gは個別に指定する必要があり、模様の画像だけでTuring機構とは判定できません。 限定した実行例：a=0.1,b=0.9、拡散係数0.01/1、長さ2πの1次元周期Schnakenberg系。旧線形発現例を保持し、固定した反射対称の有限振幅初期値の非線形発展と成長後パターンを独立Fourier–Galerkin/Radau参照および空間・時間細分化で比較します。一般の模様選択、2次元、生物実験への較正、流体連成には広げません。
note.en: A framework for diffusion-driven pattern onset around a homogeneous reaction equilibrium, not a unique choice of f and g. A spot image or unequal diffusion coefficients alone do not establish a Turing mechanism. Boundary conditions determine the available modes. Scoped executed example: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. No general pattern selection, 2D, biological calibration or fluid-coupling claim.

assumptions.ja: 無次元a=0.1,b=0.9、平衡(1,0.9)、拡散係数(0.01,1)、周期k=2、初期振幅1e-4。線形t=1と非線形t=4の短い計算に限定します。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless a=0.1,b=0.9, equilibrium(1,0.9), diffusivities(0.01,1), periodic k=2 and initial amplitude1e-4. Restrict runs to linear t=1 and nonlinear t=4.

reference_note.en: Compare linear numerical fields with SciPy expm of continuum J-k²D and measure spatial convergence. Quantify the nonlinear run against a semidiscrete linear matrix exponential as a small-amplitude check, not validation of mature morphology.

scope.ja: t=8までの有限振幅反応拡散を、独立なFourier–Galerkin参照・格子と時間刻み収束・新しい高調波で検証します。
scope.en: Validate a finite-amplitude reaction-diffusion transient to t=8 with an independent Fourier–Galerkin reference, grid/time convergence and newly generated harmonics.

assumptions.ja: 1D周期x∈[0,2π)、a=.1,b=.9、D=(.01,1)。共通初期値u=1+.08cos2x+.01cos4x、v=.9−.03cos2x−.002cos4x。反射対称かつπ周期の不変部分空間で、原点を固定します。
assumptions.en: 1D periodic x∈[0,2π), a=.1,b=.9,D=(.01,1). Common IC u=1+.08cos(2x)+.01cos(4x), v=.9−.03cos(2x)−.002cos(4x), restricted to a reflection-even, pi-periodic invariant subspace with a fixed origin.

limits.ja: 選択対称性を持つ1D教育用モデルで、乱数からの自由な波数選択・位相安定性・2D斑点・実生物の較正を検証しません。原著の係数や実験の再現ではありません。陰的midpointはA安定でもL安定・無条件正値ではなく、反応でu+vは保存しません。初回粗刻みは不合格で、受入基準を変えず時間解像度を強化した履歴を保持。量子計算は追加しません。
limits.en: A selected-symmetry1D educational model: no test of free noise-driven wavenumber selection, phase stability,2D spots or biological calibration. Not an original-paper reproduction. Implicit midpoint is A-stable but not L-stable or unconditionally positive; reactions do not conserve u+v. The initial coarse protocol failed; temporal resolution was strengthened while retaining every acceptance threshold and the failed record. No quantum calculations.

reference_note.ja: 空間も異なるcosine Fourier–Galerkin＋Radau参照（K32/64/96、cubic投影M=4(K+1)>4K、analytic Jacobian）とraw L1/L2/L∞を比較。参照のK感度とODE公差感度を別検査し、時間次数は同じFD半離散系を別実装Radauで積分した値に対して測定。平均L1・RMS L2・最大L∞を成分ごとに求め悪い方を採用。反応収支・全step正濃度・初期ゼロのk≥5（本対称性で最初はk6）・線形化との差を記録します。 収束ノルムと参照感度は固定最終時刻で判定し、途中スナップショット誤差は別の推移診断です。
reference_note.en: Compare raw L1/L2/L∞ with a spatially independent cosine Fourier–Galerkin/Radau reference (K32/64/96, cubic projection M=4(K+1)>4K, analytic Jacobian). Separately check K and ODE-tolerance sensitivity. Measure time order against a separately implemented Radau integration of the SAME FD semidiscretization. Norms are per-species mean-absolute/RMS/maximum, then the worse species. Record source/sink balance, every-step positive concentrations, initially absent k≥5 (first allowed k6 here), and departure from linearization. Convergence norms and reference sensitivities are assessed at the fixed final time; intermediate snapshot errors are separate evolution diagnostics.

name.ja: 同じ非線形反応拡散でLie–TrotterとStrangを比較する
name.en: Lie–Trotter versus Strang on the same nonlinear reaction–diffusion input

scope.ja: 32格子・終了時刻1のSchnakenberg反応拡散を、同じ入力・部分ソルバーでLie–TrotterとStrangにより進めます。4段階の時間刻みで1次／2次の収束、参照の感度、反応収支と未収束時の失敗を確かめる軽量な比較例です。
scope.en: Advance a 32-point Schnakenberg reaction–diffusion problem to T=1 with matched inputs and subsolvers. Four step sizes check first-/second-order temporal convergence, reference sensitivity, reaction balance and failure on nonconvergence in a lightweight comparison.

assumptions.ja: 無次元の1D周期区間[0,2π)、N=32、a=.1,b=.9、D=(.01,1)。u₀=1+.08cos2x+.01cos4x、v₀=.9−.03cos2x−.002cos4xは既存の有限振幅例と同じ初期場です。今回の終時刻はT=1、ステップ数16/32/64/128、共通出力時刻0/.25/.5/.75/1。反射対称・π周期の限定入力です。
assumptions.en: Nondimensional 1D periodic [0,2pi), N=32, a=.1, b=.9, D=(.01,1). The initial fields u₀=1+.08cos2x+.01cos4x and v₀=.9−.03cos2x−.002cos4x match the earlier finite-amplitude example. This new run ends at T=1, uses 16/32/64/128 steps and common output times 0/.25/.5/.75/1. The fixed input is reflection-even and pi-periodic.

limits.ja: 固定格子での採用合成法の時間誤差であり、分割誤差と反応中点則の離散誤差を含みます。連続PDEの厳密解・空間収束・独立PDE実装の照合とは呼びません。u+vは反応で保存せず、正濃度は固定入力での観測です。計算費は実際の部分流呼出し数で示し、速度の順位やStrangの一般的優越を主張しません。既存Schnakenberg問題の追加比較で、物理問題数・共通22例・旧配布版の公差や成功履歴を増減・変更しません。長時間パターン・2D・一般境界は対象外です。
limits.en: This measures temporal error of the adopted compositions at fixed space, including splitting and midpoint-reaction discretization errors. It is not an exact continuum solution, spatial convergence check or independent PDE-engine comparison. Reactions do not conserve u+v; positivity is observed only for the fixed input. Work is reported as actual subflow calls, without runtime rankings or universal Strang superiority. This additional comparison of the existing Schnakenberg problem changes neither physical-problem counts, the common 22 examples, old release criteria nor success history. Long-time patterns, 2D and general boundaries are outside scope.

reference_note.ja: 参照は同じFD半離散系を実空間の疎行列・別記述の反応RHSで組み、分割せずRadauで積分した数値解です。Radauの公差細分化と別のDOP853で参照自身の差を測り、最細Strang誤差との比を判定します。ノルムは成分ごとの平均L1・RMS L2・最大L∞を求めて悪い成分を採用し、4つの正の共通出力時刻の最大値で次数を測定。Newton公差感度、全副段階の正濃度、反応source/sink収支と逆順Lieの対照も記録します。
reference_note.en: The reference independently assembles the SAME FD semidiscretization with a real-space sparse matrix and separately written reaction RHS, then integrates it unsplit with Radau. Tighter Radau and separate DOP853 runs measure reference sensitivity relative to the finest Strang error. Norms are per-species mean L1, RMS L2 and maximum L∞, then the worse species; refinement uses the maximum across the four common positive observation times. Also record Newton-tolerance sensitivity, positive tested substeps, reaction source/sink balance and reversed-Lie ordering.
